dg-APL-211357.title: Neptune Systems COR-20 Intelligent Return Pump (2000 GPH)
dg-APL-211357.summary: A quiet, controllable DC return pump that moves water from the sump back to the display tank. It works on its own with the included controller, or connects to a Neptune Apex for advanced control.
rows: Inside the sump (submersible) or outside it (inline)
Included driver with onboard speed control. With an Apex (AquaBus port) you also get feed modes, IQ-Level min/max flow, and temperature, wattage and flow monitoring
notes: Some features need an Apex controller.

dg-APL-253433.title: Sicce Scuba Preset Heater, 50 W
dg-APL-253433.summary: A plug-and-play submersible heater that's preset at the factory, so there's nothing to adjust. Sized for small tanks.
rows: Shuts itself off when out of the water. Shatter-resistant glass
notes: Fixed at 77°F. If your animals need a different temperature, choose an adjustable heater.
